name: Nova NV-1290 Foldable Hair Dryer | 1000W Hot Air Styling & Quick Drying Machine
description:
The Nova NV-1290 Foldable Hair Dryer delivers powerful 1000W performance for quick drying and smooth styling. Designed with a hot flow option, it helps maintain hair health while ensuring shine and softness. Compact, lightweight, and foldable, it’s perfect for both home use and travel. Built with premium materials, this dryer combines durability, efficiency, and convenience.
Key Features
 1000W power for fast and effective drying
 Hot flow option for smooth, shiny hair
 Foldable and compact design for portability
 Lightweight and easy to handle for everyday use
 Premium build quality for long-lasting performance
 Suitable for all hair types
Ingredients / Materials
Material: Premium ABS Plastic
Power: 1000W
Design: Foldable, lightweight body
How to Use
 Plug in and switch ON
 Select hot flow mode for styling and drying
 Direct airflow from roots to tips for best results
 Fold and store safely after use
Package Includes
 1 × Nova NV-1290 Foldable Hair Dryer
 1 × User Manual
